plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: Narrated explainer lectures with visuals at the center: elicit the story, set final-quality style frames, shoot chapters in parallel and review on a local desk. Rich objects, tactile-only sound, content-sized holds, one timeline and deterministic checks. The user locks the story and says when to ship.

plugins.name: walk-me-through
plugins.description: Explain one mechanism as a click-through HTML page: one change per click on a stage drawn from the real data, one short caption line, a click list approved before building, and a checker that enforces the rules.

plugins.name: correctness
plugins.description: Find the bugs example tests cannot reach in stateful, concurrent or message-driven code: a property catalog with evidence, verified fakes, a workload with faults (Hegel, or Bombadil for UIs), input review, mutation testing and an audit of stored data. Follows Antithesis's public skills, without needing the product.
